name: @epoch/marketplace-host
description: Epoch Marketplace HOST (W023, service layer) — the long-running in-memory reference host: listing lifecycle sessions (draft -> submitted -> published; publication seals the immutable version), entitlement evaluation sessions (check + grant/revoke transitions with full provenance and immediate revocation), payment-port registration and check passthrough (payment state never authority), idempotent duplicate-suppressed usage metering intake, deterministic usage-account folds, developer revenue record intake, tenant-scoped reads (R12), and health/liveness as typed data. NO persistence, NO network, NO real processes; the typed domain model lives in @epoch/marketplace (kernel).
